problem.name: SIGNED_LITERAL_SUBSTITUTION_TRANSPORT_DISCOVERY
problem.input: A target CNF A and source CNF B.
problem.question: Does there exist a map phi from variables of A to signed literals over variables of B, repetitions allowed, such that every target clause image is either tautological or contains some source clause as a subset?
problem.verification: A supplied phi and clause witnesses are checkable in polynomial time.

theorem.claim: SIGNED_LITERAL_SUBSTITUTION_TRANSPORT_DISCOVERY is NP-complete, already when A and B are monotone 2CNFs and B is the fixed 3-clause encoding of K3.
construction: Given a graph G=(V,E), build G_triangle by adding for every original vertex v two private vertices a_v,b_v and the private triangle edges {v,a_v},{a_v,b_v},{b_v,v}, while retaining every original edge of G.
Let target A_G be the monotone 2CNF with one clause (x_u OR x_v) for every edge of G_triangle.
Let source B_K3 be the monotone 2CNF on y1,y2,y3 with clauses (y1 OR y2),(y1 OR y3),(y2 OR y3).

signed_edge_relation.description: For a monotone target edge clause, a valid signed substitution image either contains one of the three positive K3 edge clauses, or is tautological because the two endpoints map to opposite signs of the same source variable.
signed_edge_relation.induced_six_literal_graph: The allowed adjacency graph on signed literals {+y1,+y2,+y3,-y1,-y2,-y3} consists of the positive triangle plus one negative leaf -yi adjacent only to +yi for each i.
signed_edge_relation.key_fact: The only triangle in this six-literal graph is the positive triangle {+y1,+y2,+y3}.

forward_direction: If G has a proper 3-coloring, map every original vertex v to the corresponding positive yi.
For each private triangle, map its two private vertices to the other two positive colors.
Every target edge then maps to one of the three B_K3 clauses, so a valid substitution certificate exists.
reverse_direction: Suppose a valid signed substitution exists.
Each private triangle in G_triangle must map to a triangle in the induced six-literal allowed-adjacency graph.
The only such triangle is the positive K3, so every original vertex v is mapped to one of +y1,+y2,+y3.
For every original edge {u,v}, its image must then contain a positive K3 edge, which forces distinct positive colors for u and v.
Thus the images of original vertices define a proper 3-coloring of G.
theorem.membership_in_NP: The substitution map has linear size and each clause image/witness can be checked in polynomial time.

sibling_lift.parent_3cnf: P_G = { z OR C : C in A_G } union { NOT z OR D : D in B_K3 }.
sibling_lift.effect: The discovery hardness already holds for genuine sibling formulas of one width-3 CNF parent.

effect_on_R44BS.meaning: R44BS is an exact constructive safe-deletion relation, but unrestricted discovery of such substitutions cannot itself supply the universal polynomial L3 mechanism unless P=NP.
effect_on_R44BS.remaining_escape: This theorem does not force the parent to be maximum-deficiency-critical and does not rule out polynomial discovery for a structurally restricted critical subclass.

next_exact_question: Is there a fixed-parameter/fixed-support substitution class that is polynomially discoverable and strictly contains the R44BS witness, and can exact critical families refute universal coverage of that class?
